# LLM HTML Collections

**Five collections of HTML studies generated by language models, gathered into one repository for local browsing and comparison.**

The original collections are from [MiaAI-Lab](https://github.com/MiaAI-Lab). The live demos below are their deployments, not redeployments from this repository.

| Model | Local collection | Original MiaAI-Lab deployment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Fable 5.2 | [`collections/fable-5.2/`](collections/fable-5.2/) | [Open the gallery](https://miaai-lab.github.io/Claude-Fable-5.2-HTML-Files/) |
| Claude Opus 5.5 | [`collections/opus-5.5/`](collections/opus-5.5/) | [Open the gallery](https://miaai-lab.github.io/Claude-Opus-5.5-100-HTML-Files/) |
| Claude Sonnet 5.5 | [`collections/sonnet-5.5/`](collections/sonnet-5.5/) | [Open the gallery](https://miaai-lab.github.io/Sonnet-5.5-100-HTML-Files/) |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 | [`collections/haiku-5.5/`](collections/haiku-5.5/) | [Open the gallery](https://miaai-lab.github.io/Haiku-5.5-100-HTML-Files/) |
| MiMo V2.6 Pro | [`collections/mimo-v2.6-pro/`](collections/mimo-v2.6-pro/) | [Open the gallery](https://miaai-lab.github.io/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-100-HTML-Files/) |

Each directory preserves the files and relative paths of its source snapshot, including prompts and images where supplied. See [SOURCES.tsv](SOURCES.tsv) for the exact fork URLs and commit IDs. Identically named studies from different models are kept separately.

No umbrella license is asserted for the imported material. Check the original publications' terms or obtain permission before redistributing the collection. No demos are deployed from this repository.
